targetText: In the Russian edition of this book I somewhat incorrectly described the conduct of the Communist Party of Holland as a whole, in the sphere of international revolutionary policy.
explanation: Key theoretical concept in Appendix V: Note from Wijnkoop, June 30, 1920: Marxists analyze how structural economic conditions determine political and social relations under capitalism.

targetText: We feel, nevertheless, that we must protest against your laying the responsibility for their actions on the Communist Party.
explanation: Modern relevance: understanding these underlying systemic dynamics helps clarify contemporary economic policies and labor movements.
